title: Publish an event and handle it in a job
prompt: When a note is deleted, other parts of the app need to react without slowing down the request. Create src/events.ts exporting `noteDeleted`, an event named "note.deleted" whose payload is { noteId, ownerId } (both uuids). Publish it from the DELETE /notes/:id handler after the note is deleted. Create src/jobs.ts with a job named "notify-owner" that handles that event (for now it only logs the note id with console.log), subscribe it to the event and register it in src/app.ts.
